_note: Checked-in routing corpus for component-decomposer. CAVEAT: routing-eval measures LEXICAL TOKEN OVERLAP ONLY — it is a legibility aid, not a verdict. The indirect/paraphrase positives are deliberately low-overlap to test recall; a lexical miss on them is a PROXY artifact (paraphrase-blindness), NOT a description defect. The negatives are ADVERSARIAL: each is a real trigger for a NAMED confusable sibling. Every *-decomposer in this repo shares the 'decompose / design / grade on two crossing axes' vocabulary, so the family collides on surface tokens by construction. As of 0.3.0 this skill covers a ZERO-DEP WEB COMPONENT (Custom Element, geometry, FACE, COMPOSE×REALIZE) AND how components NEST + WIRE (compose) up to the MODULE — the tier ladder primitive → component → module, seams/slots/overflow, cross-component state (absorbed from the retired ui-decomposer draft). The two sharpest collisions: (1) code-decomposer (also says 'design this', 'grade this', 'is it production-ready') owns a UNIT OF CODE (function/module, SPEC×EXECUTION, tests); (2) layout-decomposer — the MODULE → app-shell seam — owns the APP SHELL / PAGE region grid / which archetype (OUTSIDE-IN×INSIDE-OUT); the module is the largest thing THIS skill owns and it HANDS the shell UP. The layout-decomposer negatives deliberately use 'app shell / page / region grid / archetype' to fence that boundary. query/type/regex own SQL/schemas/patterns; ui-build-components owns the actual code emission. The negatives surface exactly these collisions; re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
